metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: AI — Database Prompt Injection via SQL
properties.description: Detects prompt injection attacks targeting AI-connected databases through SQL queries
properties.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == "SQLSecurityAuditEvents" | where statement_s contains "database" or action_name_s contains "prompt" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), database_name_s, session_server_principal_name_s | where count_ > 2 // AZ-AI-DB-006
